sections.shortTitle: Defence of Pakistan Second Amendment Ordinance 1965
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLIII OF 1965
ORDINANCE XLIII OF 1965
DEFENCE OF PAKISTAN
(SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965
An Ordinance further to
amend the Defence of Pakistan
Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, 16th October 1965]
No. F. 24(1)/65-Pub. The following Ordinance
made by the President on the 15th October 1965 is hereby published for general
information:
Whereas it is expedient
further to amend the Defence of Pakistan I Ordinance, 1965 (XXIII of 1965), for
the purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas a
Proclamation of Emergency issued under clause (1) of Article 30 of the
Constitution is in force;
And whereas the
President is satisfied that immediate legislation is necessary to meet the
emergency;
Now, therefore, in
exercise of the powers conferred by clause (4) of Amide 30 of the Constitution,
read with clause (2) of Article 131 thereof, and alai other powers enabling him
in that behalf, the President is pleased to awoke and promulgate the following
Ordinance :‑
1. Short title and commencement. (1) This Ordinance may
be called Defence of Pakistan (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1965.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
